Integrated with Firebase authentication for User authentication and realtime database for secure storage and real-time data. Future features include cab, bike, auto and airport taxi services.

A secure password manager mobile app built using XML, Java and Firebase, featuring responsive UI for easy password management and quick access. Integrated with Firebase authentication for secure login and Realtime data for encrypted password storage and synchronization across devices. Future features include biometric login and password strength analysis.

• Firebase integration
 • Password generator logic
 • Manage stored passwords
 • Real-time database handling
 • Android Fragments and Intents
 • Copying passwords to clipboard
 • Password encryption and decryption algorithm

A dual chess timer mobile app built using XML and Kotlin, featuring responsive UI for smooth gameplay and time management. Supports three timer modes: Classic, Bronstein and Fischer, with accurate countdown and increment handling for competitive matches. Future feature includes home screen widgets for quick access and real-time tracking.

• Motion Layout
 • Dual Timer logic
 • Responsive UI Design
 • Maintaining consistent UI
 • Linear and Constraint Layouts
 • Play, Pause Stop States Management
